caption: The drawing shows a single red wooden writing desk or secretary desk, viewed from an angle that displays the front and the right side. The desk has four straight, slender, tapered legs with subtle decorative elements near the top and bottom. The main body of the desk consists of a lower section with a single, wide drawer that features two round knobs or handles, and a diamond-shaped keyhole in the center. Above the drawer is a large, downward-angled front panel, also with a keyhole, which appears to function as a drop-down writing surface. The surface of the desk is uniformly colored in a dark, rich red with visible shading and texture to suggest wood grain. The desk is centered within a plain, light beige or off-white background bordered by a single, thin, rectangular outline. No other objects or decorative elements are present in the composition.
title: Desk
